recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎完全被細胞填滿、脂肪細胞極少，並由單一形態、核圓而淡染的中型細胞呈片狀（sheets）取代正常三系造血，符合急性白血病的骨髓切片表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with near-complete loss of fat
Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with round to oval nuclei, open chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Normal trilineage hematopoiesis, including megakaryocytes, largely effaced
Intact bony trabeculae and small vessels with extravasated red cells
Cytologic detail of blasts limited at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-total replacement of fat. The intertrabecular spaces are filled by diffuse sheets of monotonous immature-appearing cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm, with marked reduction of normal erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements. No granulomas or fibrosis are evident on H&E. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by acute leukemia; lineage and genetic classification (AML with t(6;9)) require aspirate, flow cytometry and cytogenetics.

ddx.vs: Also forms sheets of blasts on core biopsy, so IHC (MPO, CD34, TdT, PAX5, CD3) or flow cytometry is required to assign lineage.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma / Burkitt lymphoma involvement
ddx.vs: Cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli or show starry-sky pattern, and are CD20/PAX5 positive and CD34/TdT negative.
Retains dysplastic maturing trilineage hematopoiesis with blasts below 20% rather than diffuse sheets of blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Shows cohesive nests and desmoplasia with lineage-specific IHC (keratin, synaptophysin, CD99) and is CD45 negative.
